tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards when the sky background is off or loading; also the reduced-motion fallback base.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, day cards, search field, popovers, map popup. All reading text sits on this or on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside cards: chart plot area, compare-table header row, skeletons. Use `ink` or `ink-muted` text here, not `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Translucent panel laid over the animated sky behind the hero heading and the header, so text never sits on moving pixels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and temperatures on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: admin region and country in suggestions, sunrise/sunset line, comfort explanation, units. On all three surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: footer credits, footer joke, timestamps, placeholder. On `surface` and `surface-raised` only (4.1:1 on `surface-sunken` in light — too low).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and quiet buttons; 3.5:1 or more on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Lake teal. Primary button fill, links, active pin, map marker, hourly chart line. As text: on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected suggestion row, hover on day cards, pinned-city chip ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Weekend sun. Fill of the weekend marker and the Sat/Sun day-card top rule. Never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the WeekendHighlight panel.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Weekend labels as text (“Ці вихідні”) on `accent-soft`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: comfort-good
tokens.usage: Comfort 70–100 badge fill. Always shown with the number and the word “Комфортно”. Differs from `comfort-poor` by 3.4:1 in lightness in both themes.

tokens.name: on-comfort-good
tokens.usage: Text on `comfort-good`.

tokens.name: comfort-fair
tokens.usage: Comfort 40–69 badge fill, with the word “Терпимо”. Low contrast against the page by design: the badge always carries a `line-strong` hairline.

tokens.name: on-comfort-fair
tokens.usage: Text on `comfort-fair`.

tokens.name: comfort-poor
tokens.usage: Comfort 0–39 badge fill, with the word “Некомфортно”.

tokens.name: on-comfort-poor
tokens.usage: Text on `comfort-poor`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a failed-request Notice. Calm, not alarming: never a full red fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 6:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-line
tokens.usage: Hourly temperature line.

tokens.name: chart-area
tokens.usage: Fill under the hourly temperature line.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the now-marker track.

tokens.name: sky-day-top
tokens.usage: Animated background, clear day, top of the gradient. Same in both UI themes: the sky follows the place's sunrise/sunset, not the UI theme.

tokens.name: sky-day-bottom
tokens.usage: Clear day, bottom of the gradient.

tokens.name: sky-overcast-top
tokens.usage: Cloudy or rainy day, top of the gradient.

tokens.name: sky-overcast-bottom
tokens.usage: Cloudy or rainy day, bottom.

tokens.name: sky-night-top
tokens.usage: Night, top of the gradient.

tokens.name: sky-night-bottom
tokens.usage: Night, bottom of the gradient.

tokens.name: sky-cloud
tokens.usage: Drifting cloud shapes, day and night.

tokens.name: sky-rain
tokens.usage: Rain streaks.

tokens.name: sky-snow
tokens.usage: Snow particles.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero question above the search. Once per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Тепло й сухо, легкий вітер. Гарний день для прогулянки.
styles.usage: Comfort explanation, notices, all running text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Suggestion secondary line, sunrise/sunset, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Weekday on day cards, badge words, button text at small size.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer credits, footer joke, map attribution.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Header live clock. Tabular, so digits do not jitter.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Precipitation, wind, UV figures on day cards and in the compare table.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between figures on a day card; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Day card inner padding; suggestion row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gap in the 7-day grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, suggestion rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, day cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Section cards, map frame, WeekendHighlight.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pinned-city chips and the comfort badge when shown as a number only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards floating over the animated sky.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Search suggestions list and map popup.

tokens.name: z-sky
tokens.usage: Animated background layer. Always `pointer-events: none`.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Page content above the sky.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Search suggestions, above the map's own panes.
